seoTitle: Edit Desktop and Mobile Separately in Squarespace
metaDescription: Learn why Squarespace text and layout changes don't always carry over between desktop and mobile, and how to edit each version on its own.
intro: Squarespace lets you style your site for desktop, but mobile visitors often see text and layouts differently because of size and alignment differences. This guide covers how to switch into mobile editing mode and adjust each version independently for a consistent experience.

steps.heading: Log in and open your site
steps.body: Sign in to Squarespace, select the site or built-in domain you want to edit from your Account Dashboard, and enter the editor.

steps.heading: Make your desktop edits first
steps.body: Adjust text style, color, or layout as you normally would — these changes apply to the desktop version of your site by default.

steps.heading: Switch to the mobile view
steps.body: Inside the editor, click into the mobile view to see how your desktop changes actually render on smaller screens.

steps.heading: Adjust the mobile version independently
steps.body: Make separate adjustments to text size, spacing, or layout in the mobile view since it doesn't automatically inherit every desktop tweak.

steps.heading: Save and compare both versions
steps.body: Save your changes, then compare desktop and mobile side by side to confirm both look the way you want.

faq.question: Why does my text look different on mobile than desktop?
faq.answer: Mobile screens have different sizing and alignment constraints, so Squarespace renders text and layout blocks differently even after a desktop edit.

faq.question: Do I have to edit desktop and mobile every time I make a change?
faq.answer: For layout-sensitive changes like text size or alignment, yes — it's worth checking both views after any edit to catch mismatches.

faq.question: Can I hide certain content on mobile only?
faq.answer: Squarespace's mobile editor lets you make adjustments specific to that view, which is where you'd address content that doesn't fit well on smaller screens.

faq.question: Does this apply to all Squarespace templates?
faq.answer: The general approach of editing desktop and mobile separately applies across templates, though the exact editor options can vary by version.
